name: SqlCmdInstaller
description: Installs a specific version of Microsoft's cross-platform sqlcmd utility and adds it to the PATH.
author: PedroC88

inputs.name: versionSpec
inputs.label: Version Spec
inputs.helpMarkDown: Version range or exact version of sqlcmd to use. Use 'latest' for the most recent stable release.

inputs.name: checkLatest
inputs.label: Check for Latest Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select this option to check online for the latest release that satisfies the version spec.

inputs.name: installDirectory
inputs.label: Install Directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Specify where sqlcmd will be installed. If not specified, sqlcmd will be installed to a directory under the tools cache.

messages.VersionNotFound: SqlCmd version '%s' not found for this platform and architecture.
messages.SuccessfullyInstalled: SqlCmd version '%s' has been installed successfully.
